Hi Sonal / Tom / Elena — nice to meet you via email, Sonal — I’m Monica, AE on the account. Per Elena's ask, please find a short summary below for your review. I kept the deck-light so it can be forwarded to finance.

Summary (one paragraph): Redwood Inference provides a production-grade inference platform to run large language model features with predictable latency and cost. For CumulusHealth's pilot we recommend a two-week clinical inference pilot (2k calls/day), with a 30-day post-pilot evaluation to measure recall and cost delta versus the current rule-based system. Typical pilot range: $8-12k.

Key asks to move forward:
- Sonal: confirm whether the pilot budget can be approved as a test line item or whether we need a formal PO.
- Tom: confirm preferred RFI format and a preferred date for procurement kickoff (week of Feb 14 stated but open).
- Elena: share any required fields you want in the one-pager for Sonal (specific KPIs, stakeholders).

Security paragraph (short for finance):
- Redwood provides SOC2 Type II attestation, TLS encryption, and optional VPC/private deployments for regulated workloads. We will share a data-flow diagram and retention policy during intake; no PHI will be stored in plain text unless a HIPAA contract is in place.

Proposed next meetings:
- Procurement kickoff: Feb 15, 10:00am ET (tentative) — Tom and procurement team.
- Security intake: Feb 8, 11:00am ET (technical).

I’ll follow up with the MAP and a one-page PDF for Sonal by end of day Wednesday (9 Feb).

Thanks all — happy to jump on a quick call to walk through the one-pager.
